findings.summary: Offline replay is not integrated with the real context/worker path and therefore does not reduce actual harness phase input.
The PR #36 replay uses current-change sources instead of pinned PR #36 artifacts and declared verdicts instead of captured evidence.
Baseline and candidate derive from the same manifest, making equivalence circular.
Contributor and alternative comparisons are asserted rather than independently probed.
No persisted capsule API rejects or refreshes stale source attestations.
Trustworthy worker telemetry reports 1169262 input tokens, so proxy success cannot be presented as total or active-context improvement.
